content.description: JavaScript is a lightweight, interpreted, or JIT-compiled programming language that adds interactivity, dynamic content validation, and behavior to static HTML/CSS webpages.
Using the <script> tag in HTML documents (inline, embedded, or linked via external .js files).

sections.section_title: 2. Obtaining User Input with Prompt Dialogs

details: alert("Message");: Displays an informational popup message.
confirm("Are you sure?");: Displays a modal dialog with OK/Cancel buttons, returning a boolean (true/false).
prompt("Enter your name:");: Captures string input from the user via a text box dialog.

code_examples:
let userName = prompt("Please enter your name:");
alert("Welcome, " + userName + "!");

content.description: Assigns or modifies values in variables.
content.code_example:
let score = 10;
score += 5; // Equivalent to score = score + 5 (score is now 15)

details: Prefix (++x): Increments the value before evaluating the expression.
Postfix (x++): Increments the value after evaluating the expression.
&& (Logical AND): Returns true if all operands are true.
|| (Logical OR): Returns true if at least one operand is true.

content.description: Executes blocks of code conditionally based on evaluated boolean expressions.
Evaluates an expression against multiple case clauses, cleanly handling multi-way branching without long else-if chains.
